summary.text: Tom Craddick is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 82 who has served since 1993 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Cathy Broadrick is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Tom Craddick is the owner of Craddick Properties, president of Craddick, Incorporated, and a sales representative for Mustang Mud/Newpark Resources, Incorporated, according to Ballotpedia.
He has been affiliated with the Midland Downtown Lions Club and the Eagle Scouts.
Craddick first served in the Texas House from 1969 to 1973 for District 70, then represented District 68 from 1973 to 1983 and District 76 from 1983 to 1993.
For 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Ways & Means and Energy Resources committees.
